audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 gave the stage to Olaf in both layers while their whys all describe Zaahen winning ('your Q punishes Olaf whenever his Undertow is down', 'you win the walk-up trade', 'you out-space and out-sustain him', 'you scale slightly harder').
audit.why: Olaf has no CC without a landed Undertow, so a melee who sidesteps it wins the walk-up. The packet chart and the mirror audit both read Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 flipped to Zaahen as matched full/content pairs. Rows 0, 3 and 4 already read Skill and stay.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Ragnarok gives 'armor/MR and lifesteal'. The life steal is not from Ragnarok — it is Berserker Rage, his passive, scaling with missing health. Ragnarok's cooldown (100/90/80) was absent, as was the exact immunity condition.
audit.why: Attributing his sustain to the ultimate makes players think it goes away when R ends. It does not — it gets stronger the lower he is, which is the opposite lesson.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten: Ragnarok 100s at rank 1, immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking; Berserker Rage named as the source of attack speed and life steal, with 'never race him low'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly told the reader to trade 'when his axe is on cooldown' without mentioning that picking the axe back up RESETS Undertow's cooldown. It also never mentioned Reckless Swing's true damage, and 'E Golden Onslaught' is not one of Zaahen's abilities.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s, but Riot's text says 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.' The window the advice is built on only exists if you keep him off the axe — so the actionable instruction is to fight on the side away from where it landed. Reckless Swing is 325-range true damage on 11s at rank 1, which is why armour is the wrong buy.
audit.corrected: Axe-pickup reset written into spikes[0], spikes[2], mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t; Reckless Swing's true damage and 325 range stated; Ragnarok named as the reason Zaahen's Q knockup and W pull do not land. Fabricated E name replaced with a slot reference.

audit.why: report[8].t already calls early Oblivion Orb / Executioner's, which is right against Berserker Rage's life steal. Plated Steelcaps is still fine for his auto-attack damage even though Reckless Swing ignores it.

edits.before: Olaf's whole game is landing Undertow axes and picking them back up for the attack-speed and slow; if you sidestep the axe he has to walk at you with no CC, and your Q Darkin Glaive plus E Golden Onslaught win that trade cleanly.
edits.after: Olaf's whole game is Undertow: land the axe, then walk over it to reset the cooldown. Sidestepping is only half of it — deny the pickup and he has no slow and no CC at all, and your Q slash plus E dash win that walk-up trade cleanly.

edits.before: Olaf R Ragnarok makes him CC-immune and gives armor/MR and lifesteal, so a full committed all-in from him becomes dangerous; disengage or space with your glaive rather than facechecking a Ragnarok dive.
edits.after: Ragnarok (R) is 100s at rank 1 and makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so your Q knockup and W pull do not land. Berserker Rage gives him attack speed and life steal as he drops — never race him low.

edits.before: Once you have your first item you again out-sustain and out-space him between his Undertow cooldowns; punish the windows where his axe is down and he can't slow you, since without the axe he can't stick to you.
edits.after: With your first item you out-space him between axes — but Undertow resets the moment he picks the axe up, so fight on the side away from where it landed. Reckless Swing (E) is 325-range true damage: armour does nothing, only distance does.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 favour you as long as you respect the axe. With Q and E Golden Onslaught you win the walk-up trades Olaf is forced into once he misses Undertow, and you can space him out between his cooldowns rather than standing in the slow.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 favour you as long as you respect the axe. With your Q and E dash you win the walk-up trades Olaf is forced into once he misses Undertow — but the 9s only runs if you keep him off it, so step away from where the axe landed, not over it.

edits.before: Olaf's R Ragnarok all-in is his real spike, but between items you out-sustain and out-space him; dodge axes, punish the Ragnarok downtime, and the extended, no-CC trades tilt to you as you scale slightly harder.
edits.after: Ragnarok is his real spike, but between items you out-sustain and out-space him: dodge axes, deny the pickup, and punish the 100s of downtime. Keep Grievous Wounds up — Berserker Rage's life steal grows the lower he gets.

edits.before: - Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — CC-immune — your combo CC won’t hold him. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ragnarok (R): matchup-defining — 100s at rank 1, immune to disables while he attacks. - Undertow (Q): 9s, but it resets when he picks the axe up — deny it. - Reckless Swing (E): 325-range true damage.

edits.before: CC-immune — your combo CC won’t hold him. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Immune to disables while he attacks — engage only once its 100s is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It cuts your armour too, and retrieving the axe refunds his Q outright.

edits.before: Track Olaf's Ragnarok: CC-immune — your combo CC won’t hold him. When it is down — Combo + R him.
edits.after: Ragnarok: 100s, immune to disables while attacking. Undertow resets when he retrieves the axe.

notes: The kit file tags Undertow with a 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes' flag, but Riot's description only gives damage, Armor reduction and Move Speed reduction. Treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire; nothing here claims the axe denies Zaahen's E dash. If it genuinely grounds, the 'space him between axes' advice needs revisiting. Zaahen's E written by effect, not name, for the same reason as the rest of the champion — the kit file carries no names.
